# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **WebGPU and allocation improvements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves WebGPU packaging and reduces allocations in image and HarfBuzz text processing. Android continuous texture rendering now follows the display refresh rate, and front-buffered streams release their source stream when disposed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **WebGPU support is packaged with native WebAssembly assets** — The emdawnwebgpu implementation is now built into libSkiaSharp.a, so browser applications no longer compile its C++ source during their own link step. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — GLTextureView continuous rendering is paced by Android frame callbacks, coalescing requests and avoiding queued frames while the surface is active. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams release their source** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream now clears its managed stream reference whether or not it owns the underlying stream. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Pixel-copy and text-processing allocations reduced** — SKImage pixel copies use pinned input memory when valid, while HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding and feature formatting reuse stack or pooled buffers to reduce transient allocations. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
